jobs.description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About Defcon AI

RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF DISRUPTION. Defcon AI is an insights company that leverages artificial intelligence, mathematical optimization, data analytics, and software engineering for resilient optimization of complex systems.
In today’s dynamically changing world, Defcon AI’s technology aligns outcomes with operational goals, better decision making, and empowers customers to anticipate assess, and mitigate the impacts of disruptions.

About the Role

Defcon AI is hiring a Talent Acquisition Partner to play a critical role in our next phase of growth. This is a position for a builder – someone who thrives on high-impact technical recruiting but also finds genuine satisfaction in owning and scaling People Operations processes.

Reporting directly to the Head of HR, this role is primarily focused on technical recruiting (80%+), spanning both technical hiring (Senior Software Engineers, DevSecOps Engineers, AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and other specialized engineering roles) and non-technical hiring across the business. This is a true right-hand role: you will take full ownership of talent acquisition/recruiting and the onboarding program, freeing the Head of HR to focus on broader People strategy as Defcon AI scales.

A critical part of this role is deep fluency in Department of Defense (DoD) and government contracting talent acquisition – understanding the unique scope, timelines, and candidate pool involved in hiring technical talent for DoD contracts, including candidates who hold or are eligible for security clearances.

What You’ll Do

Technical & Non-Technical Talent Acquisition

  • Full-Cycle Ownership: Lead and execute the end-to-end hiring process for specialized technical roles including Senior Software Engineers, DevSecOps Engineers, AI/ML Engineers, and Data Engineers, as well as non-technical roles across the business.
  • DoD & Cleared Talent Strategy: Bring established fluency in recruiting for Department of Defense programs and government contracts – including security clearance requirements, timelines, and the specific talent landscape of the defense and intelligence community.
  • Hiring Manager Partnership: Collaborate closely with hiring managers and the Head of HR to scope roles, align on candidate profiles, and drive efficient hiring decisions.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Proactively build a pipeline of elite passive talent within the AI and Defense sectors, with a focused lens on candidates holding (or eligible for) security clearances.
  • Elevate Candidate Experience: Continuously refine the interview process and feedback mechanisms to ensure a top-notch experience that reflects our brand.

People Operations & Onboarding

  • Full Ownership of Onboarding: Take the lead in evolving our onboarding program from a manual process into a scalable, "day-one ready" experience that integrates new hires quickly – with full ownership of the program going forward.
  • Process Optimization: Identify and resolve friction points across the employee lifecycle – from offboarding workflows to documentation and data integrity.
  • People Ops Partnership: Serve as a true thought partner to the Head of HR on People program design and process improvement as the function scales.

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of technical recruiting experience, ideally within a high-growth startup, government contractor, or fast-paced technology environment.
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting technical talent for Department of Defense programs or government contracts, including direct familiarity with security clearance processes (Secret, Top Secret, TS/SCI) – this is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Proven ability to manage the entire talent funnel, from initial intake to complex offer negotiations.
  • A strong interest in People Operations; you don't just want to fill seats.
  • Demonstrated maturity and executive presence – comfortable operating as a strategic partner to senior leadership and engineering stakeholders, and confident navigating ambiguity independently.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and are excited to build processes from the ground up.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience designing or improving onboarding and employee lifecycle programs
  • Experience working with Greenhouse (ATS and Onboarding)

Why this role:

  • Outsized Impact: You are a critical component of our team’s growth, enabling leadership to make informed hiring decisions.
  • True Ownership: Meaningful ownership over recruiting execution and a seat at the table for People Ops improvement and program design.
  • The Mission: We are building meaningful AI technology that addresses some of the most complex challenges in national security.

What We Offer:

  • A fully remote environment
  • Competitive salary, bonus, and equity package
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family
  • Unlimited PTO, with your manager’s approval
  • Flexible work environment where you manage your work day
  • 14 weeks of fully-paid parental leave

Salary Range: $100,000-$125,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits:

For full-time roles

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.
  • Unlimited PTO, with management approval.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continued learning.
  • Optional 401K, FSA, and equity incentives available.
  • Mental health benefits are available through Tara Mind.
  • Cost effective GLP-1 solutions available through Crux.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

Applicant Data Disclosure

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that Red Cell Partners, LLC ("Red Cell") uses third-party service providers to facilitate its recruitment and hiring processes. These providers include applicant tracking systems, candidate verification platforms, and fraud detection tools (collectively, "Hiring Platforms"). Your application materials, including your résumé, cover letter, work samples, responses to application questions, and any other information you submit, may be transmitted to and processed by these Hiring Platforms for the following purposes:

  • Managing and administering your application throughout the hiring process;
  • Verifying the accuracy and authenticity of application materials, including by cross-referencing information you provide against publicly available sources and proprietary databases;
  • Identifying indicators of potentially fraudulent, fabricated, or materially misleading application content, including but not limited to discrepancies between submitted materials and publicly available professional profiles, geographic anomalies, and fabricated work histories.

Applications that are flagged through this process as containing indicators of fraud or material misrepresentation may be declined from further consideration. If you have questions about the status of your application or the evaluation process, please contact .

Red Cell requires its Hiring Platform providers to process your information solely for the purposes described above and in accordance with applicable law. Your information will be retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill these purposes and any applicable legal obligations, after which it will be deleted in accordance with Red Cell's data retention policies.

For more information about how your data is used, please refer to our Privacy Policy and Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

This is not a traditional EA role. The Senior Executive Assistant II to our VP of Customer Success operates as a trusted extension of executive leadership — equal parts strategic operator, project manager, and thought partner. You will sit at the center of a large, fast-moving organization and use your judgment, initiative, and influence to keep the VP and his team running at peak velocity.

You will own the executive experience end-to-end: anticipating needs before they're voiced, navigating complex stakeholder dynamics, and turning ambiguous requests into crisp execution. If you thrive in environments where no two days are the same and you find energy in being the connective tissue of a high-performing org, this role is for you.

This is a remote role based in the US, however candidates must be able to support west coast hours and be open to travel 1 trip per month. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You Should Apply If

  • You want to work on problems that matter. Samsara connects the physical and digital worlds — keeping workers safe, supply chains moving, and emissions in check. Your leverage as an EBP is real.
  • You're an operator, not just a coordinator. You see the system behind every calendar invite, build processes that outlast you, and default to ownership over escalation.
  • You thrive with ambiguity and pace. You can hold ten priorities, drop the right three, and communicate clearly about all of it — without being asked twice.
  • You care about the craft. Being a truly elite EBP is a skill. You're always learning, always refining, and you take pride in raising the bar for everyone around you.

What You'll Own

  • Executive presence & flow — Manage the VP's calendar, communications, and daily operating rhythm with a level of foresight that makes him feel three steps ahead.
  • Complex travel & logistics — Plan and book multi-leg domestic and international travel (~1 trip/month), anticipating buffers, prep materials, and regional stakeholder touchpoints before they're requested.
  • Stakeholder management — Act as a trusted liaison to senior leaders, investors, and cross-functional partners internally and externally; you represent leaders in every interaction.
  • Operational continuity — Own expenses, team meeting agendas, action item tracking, and the behind-the-scenes coordination that keeps a large org accountable and moving.
  • Events & onsites — Lead planning and execution of team onsites, offsites, and executive events with high attention to detail and a sharp instinct for what makes the experience feel intentional.
  • Special projects — Take on high-impact, time-sensitive projects that cut across the org — from preparing exec briefings to driving cross-functional initiatives on the VP's behalf.
  • Culture carrier — Champion Samsara's operating principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) and model them every day.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

  • 6+ years of experience supporting VP-level or above executives and GTM/Sales experience in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven ability to operate with discretion, sound judgment, and high EQ in sensitive or ambiguous situations
  • Exceptional communication skills — you write, speak, and represent with polish and precision
  • A track record of building systems and processes that scale, not just executing tasks
  • Ability to maintain San Francisco business hours (Pacific Time), regardless of location
  • Flexibility to travel approximately once per month for onsites and executive support

Nice-to-haves

  • Familiarity with enterprise SaaS or high-growth technology environments
  • Comfort with productivity and AI tools (Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, AI assistants)

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$103,232.50—$173,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Test Support Operations Associate - English & French
jobs.excerpt: Help applicants be seen for their full potential.
jobs.description:
Help applicants be seen for their full potential.

Every year, thousands of people complete Casper as part of applying to programs in medicine, nursing, and other professions. Casper is designed to understand the human skills that matter in these professions, helping universities and colleges see more of who an applicant is and the potential they bring, beyond academic achievement alone.

For applicants, completing Casper can be an important step toward the education and career they’re working toward. Behind every test is a team making sure the experience runs smoothly, problems are caught and resolved, and applicants get the support they need along the way.

That’s where you’ll come in.

As a Test Support Operations Associate, you’ll help run the day-to-day operations behind Casper. You’ll prepare for upcoming tests, make sure everything is ready to go, monitor what’s happening during testing, investigate issues when they arise, and help ensure each test is completed successfully.

Casper will be your primary focus to start, but the work won’t necessarily stop there. Acuity is developing new ways for institutions to understand and develop the human skills that matter in education and professional practice. As those experiences become available, you’ll have the opportunity to learn how they work and help build the operational support needed to deliver them reliably, too.

You’ll also help us make the work better. The people closest to an operation often see things others don’t: a process that could be simpler, an issue that keeps coming up, or a better way to help applicants. We want you to notice those things, ask questions, and contribute ideas as you learn.

You don’t need previous experience in test or assessment operations. We’ll teach you how Casper works and support you as you build your knowledge and confidence. What matters most is that you’re someone people can rely on, you pay attention to the details, you like figuring things out, and you want to keep learning.

This role requires professional fluency in English and French. English is the primary language we work in at Acuity, while your French will help us support French-speaking applicants and other operational needs as they arise.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based anywhere in Canada.

Before you apply: Thoughtful use of AI is encouraged. If you use it to support your application, make sure it helps communicate your experience clearly and accurately. The strongest applications are authentic, original, and unmistakably yours.

The Work You’ll Do

Running Casper involves a lot of moving pieces. Before each test, everything needs to be prepared and checked. While applicants are completing the test, the team monitors what’s happening and responds when something doesn’t go as expected. Afterwards, there’s work to complete before that test is truly finished.

You’ll be part of the team making all of that happen.

You’ll start by learning the processes behind Casper and taking responsibility for specific pieces of the work with support from experienced teammates. As you build your knowledge and confidence, you’ll take on more of the day-to-day operations independently.

Some days, you’ll be preparing for upcoming tests and checking that everything is ready. Other days, you might investigate an issue, help process a retake, support the team during a busy testing period, or work with a teammate to figure out what needs to happen next.

And because running tests well isn’t just about following a process, you’ll also help us improve how the work gets done. You’ll notice where something is unclear or repetitive, help keep our documentation useful and up to date, and look for practical ways, including using AI, to make our processes simpler and more reliable.

In your first few months, you’ll:

  • Learn how Casper works and how the different pieces of test operations come together.
  • Build confidence preparing for and supporting test cycles alongside experienced teammates.
  • Learn the processes we use to investigate issues, support applicants, and know when something needs to be escalated.
  • Take responsibility for recurring operational work, with support as you build your knowledge and judgment.
  • Get to know the people and teams you’ll work with across Acuity.

As you grow, you’ll:

  • Take increasing ownership of day-to-day Casper test operations from preparation through post-test follow-up.
  • Investigate and resolve operational issues independently within your scope, bringing in others when needed.
  • Help support retakes and other applicant needs that arise around testing.
  • Build your knowledge of other assessment experiences as they become available, helping the team develop the operational processes needed to support them reliably.
  • Spot patterns, recurring problems, or unnecessary steps and help improve the processes behind them.
  • Keep operational documentation clear, accurate, and useful for the team.
  • Use AI and other tools thoughtfully to make recurring work faster, clearer, and more consistent.
  • Become someone teammates can rely on for strong execution and growing knowledge of Casper operations.

The Impact You’ll Have

The details matter when someone is completing a test that’s part of their application. When Casper runs smoothly, applicants can focus on showing who they are rather than worrying about what’s happening behind the scenes.

Your work will help make that possible.

Create a reliable test experience. Help make sure Casper tests are prepared carefully, run smoothly, and are completed successfully.

Support applicants when it matters. Help resolve issues thoughtfully and quickly so applicants have a fair and consistent experience when something doesn’t go as planned.

Make our operations stronger. Notice recurring problems, unclear processes, or unnecessary steps and help us find better ways of working.

Protect the quality of every test. Bring care, attention to detail, and good judgment to operational work where small details can have a meaningful impact.

Help the team get better over time. Share what you’re learning, strengthen documentation, and contribute ideas, including thoughtful uses of AI, that make future test cycles easier and more reliable.

The work often happens behind the scenes, but its impact is very real. Every test you help prepare, every issue you help resolve, and every process you improve contributes to an experience where applicants can focus on what matters: the opportunity to show more of who they are and the potential they bring.

What Success Looks Like

You won’t be expected to know everything on day one. Success starts with learning how Casper works, building confidence in the processes you support, and becoming someone the team can increasingly rely on.

In your first few months, success looks like:

  • Building a strong understanding of Casper and the operational work behind each test.
  • Learning established processes and completing your work carefully and consistently.
  • Asking questions when you need context and beginning to recognize when you can move forward independently.
  • Paying attention to the details and catching things that don’t look quite right.
  • Following through on your work and becoming a dependable teammate during busy test cycles.
  • Welcoming feedback and using it to build your knowledge, judgment, and confidence.

As you grow, success means:

  • Handling recurring operational work confidently and with increasing independence.
  • Using good judgment to investigate and resolve issues within your scope, and knowing when to bring in someone else.
  • Spotting potential problems early and taking action before they become bigger ones.
  • Looking beyond the immediate task to understand how your work affects applicants, teammates, and the overall test experience.
  • Identifying practical ways to make processes clearer, simpler, or more reliable.
  • Becoming a trusted and knowledgeable member of the team who others can count on.

Over time, you’ll build a strong understanding of how Casper operates and the judgment to handle more situations independently. As our assessment offerings evolve, you’ll also have opportunities to apply that knowledge to new experiences and help shape how we support them operationally.

You’ll know not just what needs to happen, but why it matters, what to look out for, and when something needs extra attention.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll join Acuity’s Operations - Support team, the group that helps keep Casper running smoothly today and will increasingly support new assessment experiences as they become available.

You won’t be figuring things out alone. You’ll work alongside teammates who specialize in different areas of support operations, including test execution, accommodations, communications, and enablement. You’ll learn from their experience as you build your own. The team works closely together during test cycles, sharing context, solving problems, and stepping in to support one another when things get busy.

You’ll also work with people across Acuity, including:

  • Customer Success, who work directly with the universities and programs that use Casper.
  • Product and Engineering, when operational issues connect to how Casper works or where the product could be improved.

Because you’ll be close to the day-to-day test experience, you’ll often see things others don’t. The questions you ask, patterns you notice, and issues you surface can help teammates and other teams understand what’s happening and make better decisions.

As you grow in the role, you’ll build relationships across these teams and develop a broader understanding of how all the pieces come together to create a reliable experience for applicants.

What Will Help You Thrive Here

There’s no single background that leads to this kind of work.

You might have experience in customer support, operations, administration, education, hospitality, events, or another environment where being organized, dependable, and responsive mattered.

What matters most is that you’ve had experiences that have started to build the habits this role depends on.

You’re organized and reliable. You can keep track of details, follow a process, manage competing priorities, and follow through on what you say you’ll do. When something needs to get done, people can count on you.

You’re comfortable solving problems. When something doesn’t go as expected, you don’t freeze or immediately pass it along. You gather information, think through what might be happening, and work toward a solution, while knowing when you need help.

You pay attention to the details. You notice when something seems off, incomplete, or inconsistent. You understand that in operational work, small details can make a big difference.

You communicate clearly and thoughtfully. You can explain what’s happening, ask good questions, and share the information someone else needs to move forward.

You have professional fluency in English and French. English is the primary language we work in at Acuity. Your French will help us support French-speaking applicants and contribute to other bilingual operational needs as they arise.

You’re comfortable working with AI. You’re using AI tools, or actively building your ability to use them, to organize information, solve problems, communicate more clearly, or make repetitive work easier. You’re curious about what these tools can make better, while understanding that your own judgment still matters.

How You Approach Work

Beyond experience, we’re interested in how you think, learn, and approach the work in front of you. You don’t need to have everything figured out. These are some of the qualities that tend to matter in this kind of work.

Curiosity. You like understanding how things work and why. When something doesn’t make sense, you’re inclined to ask questions, look a little deeper, and figure out what might be going on.

Good judgment. You think before you act. You’re comfortable making decisions when you have enough information, and equally comfortable asking for another perspective when you don’t.

Care. You take the work seriously because you understand there are people on the other side of it. You notice details and think about how your decisions or actions might affect someone else.

Calm under pressure. When things get busy or something unexpected happens, you’re able to focus on what matters, work through the problem, and keep moving.

A learning mindset. You’re open to feedback, new ideas, and different ways of doing things. As you learn more, you’re willing to adjust your thinking and build on what you already know.

An improvement instinct. You’re naturally interested in whether there might be a clearer, simpler, or better way to do something. You don’t need to have the solution, but you’re willing to notice opportunities and bring ideas forward.

Collaboration. You enjoy working with other people, sharing what you know, asking for input, and helping solve problems together.

How We Support You

  • Transparent compensation. The starting salary range for this role is between $60,000–$70,000 CAD. Final offers reflect experience, scope, market alignment, and internal equity.
  • Learning that grows with you. A $3,000 annual learning budget to invest in your development, whether that’s deepening technical skills, building confidence, or exploring new areas of interest.
  • Shared success. Access to employee stock options, so you share in the value you help create.
  • Remote-first work. Fully remote within Canada, with up to six weeks per year to work internationally.
  • Time to rest and reset. Self-directed vacation (most teammates take 4–6 weeks annually), monthly Acuity Days (a collective Friday off), plus a two-week company-wide closure each December.
  • Comprehensive care. Health benefits from day one for you and your dependents.
  • Future-focused support. A 2% GRSP matching program to help you plan ahead.
  • Support for growing families. A 16-week parental leave top-up beyond EI, available to all parents.

What Happens After You Apply

We review every application carefully. Whether you apply directly, are referred, or connect through a recruiter or hiring manager, you’ll receive equal consideration.

We don’t use AI to evaluate applications, though you may be automatically screened out if you don’t meet baseline requirements (e.g. Canadian residency and valid work authorization). In some interviews, AI may help with note-taking, but all evaluations and decisions are made by real humans.

Our interviews are two-way conversations. We want to understand your career, abilities, and goals, and help you assess whether this opportunity and team are the right fit for you.

Steps in the Process

Our hiring process typically takes 2–4 weeks from initial conversation to final decision.

  • Application Review. A real person reviews your application for potential fit.
  • Intro Conversation. A conversation with a member of our Talent team to learn about your career journey, what you’re looking for next, and to introduce you to Acuity, Casper, and the role.
  • Hiring Manager Conversation. A conversation focused on how you approach operational work, solve problems, use judgment, learn, and work with others. You’ll also have the opportunity to learn more about the role, the team, and the work behind delivering Casper.
  • Team Conversation & Practical Discussion. You’ll meet members of the Operations - Support team to learn more about how the team works together and explore some of the situations you might encounter in the role. We’ll be interested in how you approach problems, notice important details, use judgment, and communicate your thinking. This stage may also include a practical exercise designed to reflect the work itself.
  • Decision. The hiring manager reviews feedback from the interview team and typically makes a decision within 2 to 4 business days.
  • Offer & Reference Checks. If it’s a match, we’ll move to references and a formal offer.

Life at Acuity Insights

We’re a remote-first team of 135+ people who care deeply about our work and about each other.

Our culture is intentionally designed. As we’ve grown, we’ve made deliberate choices about how we work together, prioritizing trust, flexibility, and a sustainable pace so people can do meaningful work over the long term.

That commitment has been recognized externally. Acuity Insights has been named one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for the second consecutive year, reflecting our focus on building a strong, people-first environment.

Day to day, that shows up in how we collaborate:

  • High trust and autonomy in how work gets done
  • Thoughtful, async-friendly communication across a distributed team
  • Space for deep work, balanced with intentional moments of connection
  • A culture grounded in care, curiosity, and shared purpose

As we continue to grow, we’re focused on maintaining that balance, building a company where people can do their best work and grow over time, without losing what makes the environment feel human.

About Acuity Insights

Acuity Insights builds products that help higher education institutions make better decisions about people, from admissions through to development.

Our work is grounded in a simple idea: that people are more than their grades, and that potential can be understood and developed, not just measured.

Our Casper situational judgment test (SJT), created by researchers at McMaster University, has been completed by over 1 million applicants and is one of the most widely used open-response SJTs in higher education, backed by nearly 20 years of research.

Today, we are evolving our products to better connect assessment, insight, and development, helping institutions not just identify potential, but actively support its growth over time. As part of that evolution, we’re increasingly building toward a more connected ecosystem across assessment, education, and learner development. While teams remain focused on their individual products, we’re creating stronger connections across our platform to deliver more cohesive experiences for institutions and learners.

jobs.description:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency specializing in connecting talented professionals with remote opportunities at innovative companies worldwide.

Our client is a fast-growing, bootstrapped men’s health and wellness DTC brand focused on helping men restore essential minerals commonly missing from the modern food supply. The company combines emotionally engaging messaging with science-backed education and relies heavily on performance creative to drive customer acquisition and growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Performance Creative Strategist to own the development and execution of direct-response creative across paid acquisition channels.

You will identify winning customer angles, develop approximately 8–12 new ad concepts per week, write scripts and creative briefs, analyze performance data, and coordinate multiple agencies, editors, creators, and internal partners.

This is not a traditional brand marketing or project-management position. You will directly influence paid media performance by turning customer insights, existing footage, emerging trends, and advertising data into high-converting creative.

The ideal candidate combines strong direct-response copywriting with performance analysis and excellent creative project management. You should be comfortable moving quickly, making decisions from imperfect data, and keeping several creative partners aligned around one clear strategy.

Resposabilities

  • Develop approximately 8–12 direct-response advertising concepts each week.
  • Write scripts, hooks, briefs, headlines, and messaging tailored to specific audiences, platforms, and stages of awareness.
  • Own the monthly creative direction and ensure every agency, editor, and creator is aligned with the current winning angles.
  • Build creative strategies for Meta, AppLovin, and additional acquisition channels.
  • Review performance data to identify winning hooks, messages, formats, personas, and offers.
  • Analyze incoming footage and creative assets, identifying which pieces should be tested, reworked, combined, or retired.
  • Turn proven creative into new iterations, mashups, statics, and video variations.
  • Write clear, actionable briefs and direct freelance editors and agency partners.
  • Research competitor ads, emerging formats, customer insights, and platform-specific trends.
  • Lead a weekly creative review covering recent performance, pipeline status, learnings, and upcoming tests.
  • Coordinate agencies, editors, producers, organic content teams, creators, and brand partners.
  • Coach creative contributors on direct-response and performance-marketing best practices.
  • Present creative learnings, recommendations, and production priorities to company leadership.
  • Maintain an organized source of truth for briefs, creative status, testing results, and performance notes.
  • Establish a structured testing cadence and reduce the existing backlog of untested creative.

What Success Looks Like

  • A consistent pipeline of approximately 8–12 new direct-response concepts per week.
  • Creative agencies and production partners remain aligned around a unified monthly strategy.
  • Winning angles are expanded systematically into new hooks, formats, audiences, and variations.
  • Creative performance supports continued media scaling and sustainable customer acquisition.
  • The untested creative backlog decreases through a clear and consistent testing process.
  • Creative output remains aligned with the company’s mission, audience, and brand voice.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of experience working with direct-to-consumer brands or performance-marketing agencies.
  • A proven track record developing paid social creative for DTC or e-commerce brands.
  • Excellent direct-response copywriting and scriptwriting skills.
  • Experience translating customer research and performance data into creative concepts.
  • Strong knowledge of paid social creative across both video and static formats.
  • Understanding of creative testing, iteration, audience awareness, hooks, angles, and conversion-focused messaging.
  • Experience managing multiple agencies, editors, creators, or production partners simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills.
  • Comfortable working with Meta’s advertising ecosystem and performance analytics tools.
  • Experience using project-management and reporting tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Google Sheets, or similar platforms.
  • A direct, witty, and energetic communication style that fits a men’s health brand.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize quickly, and execute without extensive resources or bureaucracy.
  • Availability for consistent overlap with Pacific Time working hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with men’s health, wellness, supplements, or another regulated DTC/CPG category.
  • Experience working inside a high-growth DTC performance brand.
  • Familiarity with Triple Whale, AppLovin, or similar analytics and acquisition platforms.
  • Hands-on video-editing skills, particularly with Adobe tools.
  • Experience creating rough cuts, mashups, or rapid creative prototypes.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools such as Persona OS or Manus.

Benefits

You will define and deliver the roadmap for Shoppers doing in-store tasks that will enable us to build in-store intelligence to better track inventory, item location and ultimately fulfill orders accurately, efficiently, and at scale.

This role partners closely with a dedicated team of engineers, designers, and data scientists, and will collaborate broadly across Shopper and Logistics teams to drive aligned priorities.

This role sits within the Inventory Intelligence team — responsible for the end-to-end technology that powers inventory and in-store intelligence signals that are used across Instacart's platform and beyond, serving shoppers, retailers, CPGs and customers alike.

About the Job

This is an exciting opportunity to define the shopper flows using cutting edge CV technologies that build the foundations of our Instore inventory intelligence. You will develop new capabilities and improve existing products to enable high quality and high efficiency data collection that can scale to thousands of stores over the next 2 years.

  • You will own data collection experiences — from how shoppers receive and action tasks in-store, to efficiently collect data for inventory and store maps, monitoring and optimizing this as we scale.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Director of Product Management, you will be tasked with owning the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for a core segment of SentinelOne's Cloud Security portfolio, which delivers real-time protection, detection, and response across workloads, containers, identities, and data spanning public cloud, private cloud, and hybrid environments. This is a player-coach role in which you will set direction and build and lead a team of product managers while staying close to the market, the data, and the product to make sharp calls under ambiguity. You will serve as the connection between engineering, sales, marketing, and customers, translating market signals into a roadmap that wins deals and a product that customers renew.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own and evangelize the strategy and vision for your area of the Cloud Security portfolio, grounded in a clear point of view on where the market is heading.
  • Build, lead, and grow a team of product managers; set the bar for the quality of PRDs, roadmaps, pricing/packaging analysis, and customer-facing communication.
  • Maintain the product roadmap and make explicit tradeoff and prioritization calls, with the expectation of saying no to good ideas in service of the few that matter most.
  • Define and report against key business metrics for your product area, including pipeline influence, win/loss trends, retention, and usage, not just feature ship dates.
  • Partner directly with engineering leadership on architecture and sequencing decisions that affect time-to-market and total cost of ownership.
  • Work hand-in-hand with sales, solutions engineering, and marketing to sharpen positioning, train the field, and support strategic deals.
  • Engage directly with customers, prospects, and analysts to pressure-test roadmap assumptions and stay ahead of where the market is moving.
  • Represent Cloud Security in company-wide planning, tying product decisions back to revenue, margin, and competitive positioning.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 8 or more years in product management at enterprise SaaS or infrastructure companies, including 2 or more years leading and managing other product managers.
  • Direct experience owning a cloud security or cloud-native product (CWPP, CSPM, CNAPP, DSPM, or adjacent), with an understanding of the buyer, the competitive landscape, and the technical tradeoffs, not just the acronyms.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to build a pricing model, read a win/loss report, and connect a roadmap decision to its effect on ARR and margin without a finance partner walking you through it.
  • Working technical fluency with cloud architecture (AWS/Azure/GCP), containers/Kubernetes, and the shared-responsibility model, sufficient to earn credibility with engineering and with technical buyers.
  • A track record of shipping and defending a roadmap in front of skeptical stakeholders, including sales leadership, customers, and engineering counterparts.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting to executives, analysts, and customers alike.
  • Willingness to travel up to approximately 15% for customer engagements and internal planning.
  • Prior experience at a cybersecurity vendor or in a SOC/security-practitioner role is preferred.
  • Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing models is preferred.
  • Familiarity with eBPF-based or agent-based security architectures is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. The Technical Project Manager facilitates technical discussions and decision-making, adapting project plans as priorities shift to ensure teams remain aligned and projects are delivered effectively. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Project Management
    • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate roadmap priorities into executable engineering plans and ensure development resources are aligned to the highest-priority initiatives.
    • Lead the planning and execution of technical projects across the software development life cycle, from requirements through deployment.
    • Develop and maintain project timelines, milestones, and delivery plans, adjusting priorities and plans as business and technical needs evolve.
    • Track dependencies across multiple engineering workstreams and proactively identify and resolve conflicts or blockers.
    • Coordinate releases and technical initiatives across web, mobile, API, backend, and other engineering teams.
    • Monitor project health using quantitative metrics and qualitative signals, surfacing risks and opportunities to leadership early.
    • Maintain project documentation and visibility to ensure stakeholders have a clear understanding of project status, decisions, risks, and next steps.
  • Engineering Collaboration
    • Work closely with engineers and engineering leaders to unblock teams, facilitate decision-making, and ensure technical work remains aligned with product and business priorities.
    • Facilitate technical discussions and drive clarity and alignment when teams encounter complex decisions or competing priorities.
    • Coordinate sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and other project ceremonies to support effective engineering execution.
    • Understand the software development life cycle and technical dependencies well enough to identify potential risks and help teams navigate challenges.
    • Adapt project management processes and methodologies to maximize team productivity and effectiveness in a fast-moving environment.
  • External Partner & Stakeholder Management
    • Serve as a key technical point of contact for external partners, customers, and other stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout project execution.
    • Gather and translate external partner requirements into actionable technical requirements, project plans, and priorities for internal teams.
    • Coordinate technical deliverables, integrations, timelines, and dependencies across internal engineering teams and external organizations.
    • Manage competing priorities and expectations across internal and external stakeholders, proactively identifying tradeoffs and escalating issues when needed.
    • Build strong relationships with external partners and stakeholders to facilitate collaboration, resolve issues, and ensure successful delivery of technical initiatives.
    • Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and technical decisions to external stakeholders in a clear and accessible manner.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
    • Translate technical information and project status into clear, actionable updates for non-technical stakeholders.
    • Partner with Product Management to understand business and user priorities and ensure engineering execution supports broader product strategy.
    • Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, resource allocation, and project execution.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

About You

  • 5+ years of technical project management experience, ideally in a high-velocity technology or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of the software development life cycle, from requirements gathering through deployment.
  • Experience coordinating complex projects across multiple engineering teams, technical workstreams, and external stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem-solver who identifies risks, dependencies, and blockers before they impact project delivery.
  • Collaborative leader who builds trust through strong judgment, accountability, and follow-through.
  • Comfortable participating in technical discussions and working closely with engineers and engineering leadership.
  • Experience managing external partners, vendors, customers, or other stakeholders through complex technical projects.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and the ability to adapt processes based on team and project needs.

Bonus Points

  • Healthcare experience, particularly in regulated environments.
  • Experience working with healthcare providers, payers, EHRs, or other healthcare technology partners.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA compliance requirements and healthcare software development.
  • Experience with API, platform, or backend engineering projects.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Linear, GitHub, or similar project management platforms.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $115,000 - $150,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

  • Direct line to business impact: onboarding speed and quality directly affect how fast providers begin seeing patients and generating revenue; the importance of this function is recognized at C-level.
  • Shape the process, don't just run it: we're actively restructuring ownership of onboarding/offboarding, and we explicitly welcome spotting inefficiencies and building automation (Notion, Zapier) rather than following a fixed script.

Requirements

Payments Analyst

StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry. We build and scale educational apps for users around the world, combining data, technology, and an x1000 mindset to create meaningful products and sustainable business models.

We are looking for a Payments Analyst to join our Payments Division.

Payments sit at one of the most critical points in the customer journey: the moment user intent turns into revenue. As our product portfolio and global presence continue to grow, we need an analyst who will help us keep payment reporting accurate, monitor performance, identify anomalies, and support data-driven improvements across our payment flows.

You will gradually take ownership of day-to-day payment analytics while developing deep expertise in transactional data, monetization, and subscription products.

What You’ll Do

  • Maintain and improve recurring payment reports and dashboards.
  • Adapt existing reporting for new applications, markets, and business needs.
  • Create analytical reports and data extracts independently.
  • Add new filters and dimensions to existing dashboards.
  • Monitor payment performance, alerts, and week-over-week changes in key metrics.
  • Identify anomalies in payment data and conduct first-line investigations into possible causes.
  • Perform data quality checks and help maintain consistency across multiple data sources.
  • Work with large product and transactional datasets.
  • Support the Payments team with clear conclusions and actionable insights, not just raw data.
  • Collaborate with Payments, Product, Finance, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and analytical workflows.
  • Gradually contribute to more advanced payment analytics, experiments, and business hypotheses.

What We’re Looking For

  • 1-3 years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, or a similar analytical role.
  • Strong SQL skills and the ability to write queries independently.
  • Practical Python skills for data analysis and automation.
  • Working knowledge of statistics and analytical methods.
  • Experience working with large datasets and real product or business data.
  • Experience creating or maintaining reports and BI dashboards.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Ability to validate data, identify inconsistencies, and investigate anomalies.
  • Ability to clearly explain what you did, what problem you solved, and how the result was useful.
  • Strong attention to detail and respect for data accuracy.
  • An ownership mindset: you do not simply complete tasks but take responsibility for the result.
  • High learning agility and genuine interest in developing within the payments domain.
  • Clear, structured communication and willingness to raise questions or blockers early.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with payment, transactional, billing, or financial data.
  • Experience in subscription-based, web-to-app, fintech, e-commerce, gaming, or other high-volume B2C products.
  • Understanding of monetization models and online payment flows.
  • Experience with AWS Athena or Amazon S3.
  • Experience with Tableau, Apache Superset, Looker, or similar BI tools.
  • Experience automating reports or recurring analytical processes.
  • Personal, academic, or professional projects involving automation, AI tools, or real-world datasets.

Previous payments experience is an advantage, but it is not a requirement. Strong analytical fundamentals, ownership, and the ability to learn quickly matter more.

What Success Looks Like

During your first months, you will learn the Payments Division’s data, reporting logic, and key processes.

You will gradually take ownership of recurring dashboards, reports, filters, data extracts, monitoring, and alerting.

You will be able to identify issues, explain what is happening in the data, and escalate anomalies with the necessary context.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Direct business impact: Work with data at the point where customer intent becomes revenue.
  • Global scale: Analyze payment flows across multiple products, markets, and payment methods.
  • Valuable expertise: Build your career in payments, transactions, subscriptions, and monetization.
  • Professional growth: Learn directly from an experienced Senior Analyst and gradually take ownership of your analytical area.
  • Modern tools: Work with SQL, Python, AWS Athena/S3, Tableau/Superset, and AI-powered solutions.
  • Innovative environment: Experiment, improve processes, and bring your own ideas.
  • Global remote: Work remotely as part of an international product company.
  • Health support: Company-provided medical expense compensation.
  • AI tools: Company-covered AI subscriptions and other tools.
  • Balance: 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays.
  • Collaborative culture: Work with ambitious professionals who value reliable evidence, extreme ownership, energy, and speed.

Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Technical Interview
  3. Final Interview

    software engineering background in highly complex and scalable backend environments.

Accountability & Ownership –Take charge, own your craft

jobs.excerpt: COMPANY OVERVIEWAt Zuora, we do Modern Business.  We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet.
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.

THE TEAM & ROLE

Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.

Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.

The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).

You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.

YOUR MISSION

As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.

YOUR OPPORTUNITY

As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
  • Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
  • Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
  • Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
  • Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
  • Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

OUR TECH STACK: REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.

WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH

  • Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
  • Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
  • Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
  • Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
  • Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
  • Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
  • Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
  • Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
  • Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.

jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

Lease Accounting & Technical Ownership

  • Perform and review lease accounting activities, including recognition, modifications, terminations and related journal entries

Period‑End Close & Financial Reporting

Controls, Compliance & Audit

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance or related field

  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP
