​At Red River Managed Services, we provide a welcoming and positive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to do their best work, fostering a one-team mentality.Our employees work together to foster wise decision-making that relies on data, experience, and collaboration. We seek self-motivated individuals who are open to an environment based on this teamwork and shared success.

Our team works directly with our clients to create innovative solutions, challenge the status quo, and deliver first in class solutions. Our client-centric culture works to anticipate needs with an urgency to resolve issues and build long-term client relationships.

We aim to expand our growing workforce with passionate individuals who are resilient in the face of uncertainty and possess a creative spirit, all while keeping the needs of our clients top of mind to foster individual and organizational success. Interested candidates must possess a desire for growth through continuous learning and feedback.

Ideal candidates will possess the following skills and come prepared to discuss how they have experienced each of these areas in previous roles:

  • Collaboration — You bring a collaborative spirit to all interactions with others; you work to ensure everyone around you is welcomed and positioned to do their best work; you view every Red River colleague as a member of one team.
  • Creativity— You welcome new ideas and listen with the intent to understand; you are passionate and persistent in pursuit of innovative solutions; you value “brainstorming” as an expression.
  • Empathy — You take the time to understand both the needs of your clients and your team members; you anticipate client needs and address issues effectively; you work to make each client feel valued and understood; you foster loyalty and a long-term relationship.
  • Integrity— You willingly receive and give feedback; you are open about what’s working and what needs to improve; you admit mistakes openly and share learnings widely.
  • Judgment — You are intentional when making decisions, with an aim toward long-term solutions rather than quick fixes; you rely on data, training, and collaboration with others to inform your decisions.
  • Purpose— You exhibit courage in searching for the truth; you are willing to risk personal failure to help, or challenge the status quo, in the pursuit of excellence.
  • Resilience — You thrive in rapidly changing circumstances; you adapt to change; you know when to include or escalate to others; you embrace a hard challenge.
  • Selflessness — You are considerate when searching for new and different ideas; you seek what’s best for the team and organization; you discern how your actions could affect others; you seek to make those around you successful.

We are seeking a highly experienced ServiceNow ITSM Developer to support the design, development, and operational excellence of the organization’s ServiceNow platform, with a strong emphasis on IT Service Management (ITSM) capabilities.

This role is critical to ensuring the platform effectively enables ITIL-aligned processes through intuitive, user-friendly solutions that drive adoption and operational efficiency. While governance and process design are well established, this position focuses on translating those processes into scalable, low-friction experiences within ServiceNow.

This position serves as a hybrid solution-oriented and hands-on technical role, combining solution design with active development, incident support, testing oversight, and stakeholder collaboration. The ServiceNow ITSM Developer will work closely with ServiceNow leadership, technical teams, and business partners to evolve the platform in alignment with both near-term operational needs and long-term strategic goals.

The role supports a multi-year roadmap of enhancements, including service catalog expansion, user experience improvements, and continuous maturity efforts aligned to a Level 3 capability target.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain scalable, secure, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions with a focus on ITSM modules
  • Develop using Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Flow Designer
  • Configure core ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge)
  • Optimize Service Catalog items and workflows for usability and adoption
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to simplify workflows and improve user experience
  • Support incident triage, root cause analysis, and platform stability
  • Maintain development standards and governance alignment
  • Support integrations (e.g., SAP)
  • Participate in testing, deployment, and support
  • Troubleshoot platform issues and provide resolutions

Qualifications

Required:

  • 7+ years of ServiceNow experience focused on ITSM Modules
  • ACTIVE Secret Clearance
  • Experience with ServiceNow Service Operations Workspace (SOW)
  • Strong development experience with ITSM modules and scripting
  • Experience supporting production environments
  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture and ITIL

Required ITSM Experience:

  • Incident Management (including Major Incident Management)
  • Request Management
  • Problem Management
  • Change Management/Change Enablement
  • Knowledge Management
  • Service Catalog

Secondary Experience:

  • Hardware Asset Management
  • CMDB / Configuration Management
  • Service Operations Workspace (Next Experience UI / SOW)
  • Incident Communications / Major Incident tooling
  • On-call scheduling
  • Notifications & event-driven automation
  • Outage management

Preferred:

  • ServiceNow CSA or Implementation certifications
  • ITIL 4 Foundation
  • Experience with HAM, CMDB, and integrations
  • Experience in complex environments and Agile delivery

Basic Qualifications:

  • U.S. Citizenship Required

Job Title: Vice President, Market Access, HEOR and Patient Services - Radiopharma

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Description Summary

Our business purpose: We are a purpose-driven team working to drive life-changing clarity in precision diagnostics that helps uncover what’s hidden inside the body – enabling earlier, more confident decisions in the fight against diseases like Alzheimer's, cardiovascular conditions, and cancer. As part of a company that delivers both radiopharmaceutical doses and the PET imaging infrastructure needed to use them, we play a critical role in expanding access to precision diagnostics – for providers, for systems, and most importantly, for patients. What sets us apart is a combination of unmatched clinical expertise, unwavering commitment to advancing science, as well as our deep commitment to showing up with urgency, care, and empathy – helping more people move from uncertainty to understanding. We believe that behind every scan is a heartbeat and behind every heartbeat is a story, and we treat each one like it matters – because lives are shaped in moments like these.

Who thrives here: You’ll thrive here if you care deeply – about your teammates, about the people we serve, and about doing what’s right, even when it’s hard. You bring both heart and discipline to your work, with a curiosity to uncover what customers truly need and the courage to make tough calls when clarity is elusive. This is a space where ambiguity is real, decisions carry weight, and collaboration isn’t optional – it’s how we move forward. If you find meaning in building something that matters and supporting others while doing it, you’ll feel at home here.

GE HealthCare’s US Radiopharma business is seeking Executive, Market Access, HEOR and Patient services to lead the market access strategy for a growing portfolio of molecular imagine and radiopharmaceutical products across cardiology, neurology and oncology.

Job Description

This role will be responsible for leading US market access strategies across payer access, reimbursement policy, CMS and Medicaid strategy, HEOR, coverage/payment pull through, field reimbursement, patient services and provider-facing access support. This leader will play a critical role in shaping how providers, patients and health systems gain access to our products, including influencing the broader reimbursement, coverage and policy environment to support long-term RP growth.

The ideal candidate will bring strong market access leadership in complex, specialty healthcare markets, including deep understanding of reimbursement, provider economics, government payer dynamics and access execution in the field. This individual should be equally comfortable shaping strategy at the leadership level and overseeing practical execution across the market access verticals.

This is a highly visible leadership role at GE HealthCare and will partner closely with Commercial, Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Commercial Operations leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create and lead the US market access strategy for RP portfolio aligned to business priorities, growth objectives and future launches
  • Develop and execute strategies across commercial and government payer access, reimbursement policy, providers reimbursement, and access pull-through
  • Lead planning related to Medicare, Medicaid, CMS, and reimbursement policy, including assessment of coding, coverage and payment dynamics impacting the entire portfolio
  • Define and lead the HEOR and value evidence strategy in support of payer engagement, provider economics and broader market adoption
  • Oversee development of access related tools and programs including economic models, value communication assets, and evidence-based support for payer and provider discussions
  • Lead field reimbursement and patient service strategy, including education, escalation support, service model, and access-related operational support
  • Partner closely and compliantly with commercial teams to ensure access strategy supports customer onboarding, reimbursement readiness and utilization growth
  • Provide strategic guidance on provider economics and practical reimbursement barriers across hospitals, FSICs, physician practices and other target sites of care
  • Lead external market access and policy engagement strategies that help shape reimbursement and coverage environment for the entire GE HealthCare portfolio, including other segments, new product launches and acquisition product lines
  • Identify, develop and support opportunities to influence coverage frameworks, reimbursement policies
  • Help shape the evidence, health economic, and value narrative needed to support broader clinical acceptance, guidelines evolution and favorable healthcare coverage decisions
  • Support launch readiness and lifecycle management with accountability for market access SME and workstreams
  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing team and scalable operating model to support a rapidly growing business

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree in business management, public health, healthcare administration preferred
  • Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in market access, reimbursement, HEOR, health policy, payer strategy and patient services
  • Significant experience in specialty pharma, Radiopharma, molecular imaging, oncology, specialty biopharma or other complex provider-administered healthcare segments
  • Demonstrated expertise in US reimbursement an access, including Medicare/CMS and government payer strategy
  • Experience leading or shaping field reimbursement, provider support, and patient service capabilities
  • Experience leading and shaping external policy, reimbursement trends, guidelines and stakeholder engagement that influence access and coverage
  • Proven ability to lead large teams, influence senior stakeholders and operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment
  • Experience launching new products or categories
  • Experience supporting buy and bill, outpatient and imaging center site of care
  • Strong knowledge of HEOR and real-world evidence strategies for access strategies
  • Experience engaging with provider organizations, professional societies, policy stakeholders to support favorable market access conditions

jobs.title: Product Manager, Clearing Systems
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

Alpaca is building the next generation of global brokerage and clearing infrastructure. We are looking for a senior product manager who can own the clearing systems product lifecycle at a rapidly scaling self-clearing broker-dealer.

Your mission is to build and operate the systems and processes that keep Alpaca accurate, compliant, and on time across areas like core brokerage, clearing, ledger, custody, money movement, and multi-currency infrastructure. You will make clearing scale reliably as Alpaca adds asset classes, account types, trading hours, and partner institutions, and as we run a true self-clearing book at DTCC, OCC, and FICC.

This person should be able to walk into ambiguity, understand the full clearing lifecycle, design the architecture, build a working prototype, and lead a team toward production-grade infrastructure. The role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, operations, finance, compliance, and regulatory infrastructure.

What You’ll Own

You will lead the design and buildout of Alpaca’s core clearing infrastructure across brokerage, custody, ledger, asset movement, and global market expansion.

This includes:

  • Defining the long-term architecture for Alpaca’s clearing platform across accounts, positions, balances, ledgers, journals, settlements, stock record, and regulatory books and records.
  • Designing multi-currency cash and position systems that can support global equities, FX, fractional trading, options, bonds, Treasuries, fixed income, mutual funds, and other asset classes.
  • Partnering with engineering to prototype and build new clearing services rather than relying only on third-party service bureau workflows.
  • Working cross-functionally with operations, finance, treasury, compliance, legal, risk, and product to ensure the platform is scalable, controlled, and regulator-ready.
  • Translating complex clearing, custody, and regulatory requirements into clear product and engineering requirements.
  • Helping Alpaca grow from U.S.-centric brokerage infrastructure into a global, multi-asset, multi-currency clearing platform.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • 5+ years in Product Management, technical program management, or engineering on brokerage, clearing, or post-trade infrastructure.
  • 10+ years of experience in brokerage, clearing, custody, prime brokerage, trading infrastructure, financial market infrastructure, or capital markets technology.
  • Demonstrated depth on at least one clearing surface: settlement and stock record, books and records, corporate actions, margin, ACATS, DTCC processing.
  • Highly technical. Ability to work directly with engineers and product teams to turn complex domain requirements into scalable system designs.
  • Comfort shipping in parallel with Compliance, Legal, and Operations in a regulated broker-dealer environment.
  • Strong operating judgment to weigh risk, operational efficiency, capital allocation, tech feasibility, time, and budget.
  • Experience leading senior teams and influencing across functions in a high-growth environment.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

  • You helped build, convert, or modernize corporate-action processing, a security master, or a self-clearing back office.
  • Experience with global brokerage expansion, including international equities, FX, local market custody, omnibus models, sub-ledgers, and currency controls.
  • Familiarity with the B2B2C correspondent / broker-as-a-service model.
  • AI-native PM workflow: recurring use of tools like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents in PRD drafting, incident synthesis, data exploration, and prototyping.

Example Problems You Should Be Comfortable Solving

  • How should stock record reconcile to DTC, custodians, omnibus providers, internal ledgers, trading systems, and customer-facing balances?
  • How should global equities, FX, fractional shares, options, fixed income, Treasuries, and mutual funds fit into one clearing architecture?

Archenia by Marchex applies AI-generated call classification to identify whether a conversation reflects meaningful intent to transact. Customers pay for qualified outcomes, not simply for every call that connects, lasts long enough, or meets basic routing criteria.

AQL (Archenia Qualified Lead) helps customers reduce spend on noise such as existing-customer calls, unsupported services, wrong geographies, solicitations, hang-ups, and other conversations that do not represent new-business opportunities. The result is a more transparent, outcome-oriented approach to performance marketing.

Marchex is seeking a high-output Sales Development Representative to build pipeline for AQL by consistently creating new conversations with prospective buyers. This role requires a resilient, metrics-driven prospector who is energized by outbound activity, comfortable making a high volume of calls and messages across multiple channels, and persistent in finding the right path into target accounts. The right candidate has a track record of creating opportunities through disciplined prospecting, strong follow-through, and the ability to open doors in competitive, hard-to-reach markets.
You will partner closely with AQL sales, marketing, product, and revenue leaders to secure qualified meetings and sales. This role is well suited to a commercially curious seller who understands lead-buyer economics, is confident on the phone, and can make a differentiated new category easy to understand.

Job Impact
Driving new customer relationships is the lifeblood of our business. We pride ourselves on being a customer-focused company and ensuring that every experience a current or prospective customer has with Marchex is a positive one. The Sales Development Representative has an opportunity to play a critical role in growing our Leads & Analytics business by prospecting and setting appointments and partnering with our Commercial and Enterprise Sales teams.

Team
The Sales Development team is responsible for creating new customer relationships from a defined target account list of mid-size and major companies while also responding to inbound interest. Job Description:

Web Developer – .NET, Blazor and Azure - C-SAM UK

C-SAM develops specialist asset management, rental, service, certification and operational software for customers operating across the UK and international markets.
We are currently investing heavily in the development of our next-generation web application framework. This framework will modernise our established Windows-based software and provide a scalable, secure and configurable cloud platform for both existing and new customers.
We are looking for a practical and experienced Web Developer to join our development team and help build, improve and deliver this new platform.

The Web Developer will work primarily on C-SAM’s newest web application framework, developing reusable components, customer-facing modules, integrations and core platform functionality.
You will work across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
The role will also involve understanding and, where required, migrating functionality from our existing VB.NET, WinForms and SQL Server applications into the new web platform.
This is a hands-on development role suited to someone who enjoys solving real business problems, working with complex workflows and building software that is reliable, maintainable and easy for users to operate.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain functionality within C-SAM’s new .NET web application framework.
• Build reusable Blazor components, shared services and configurable application modules.
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
• Convert existing Windows application functionality into modern web-based workflows.
• Work with product owners, operational teams and customers to understand business requirements.
• Design and implement secure, scalable and maintainable solutions.
• Develop and optimise Entity Framework queries and data access services.
• Create and maintain SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions and scripts.
• Improve application and database performance.
• Build integrations with customer systems, third-party APIs and cloud services.
• Assist with data migration, cleansing and validation activities.
• Develop authentication, role-based access and permission functionality.
• Support multi-company, multi-entity and multi-customer application structures.
• Write unit tests and assist with integration, regression and user acceptance testing.
• Diagnose and resolve software defects and performance issues.
• Review code and contribute to development standards and architecture decisions.
• Produce clear technical documentation and implementation notes.
• Support application deployments to Azure environments.
• Work with AI-assisted development tools, including OpenAI Codex, to improve development speed and quality.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the framework, development processes and coding standards.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong commercial experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
• Experience developing web applications using Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, ASP.NET Core or a similar Microsoft web technology.
• Strong SQL Server knowledge, including:
o T-SQL
o Stored procedures
o Views
o Joins and aggregations
o Query optimisation
o Indexing
o Execution plans
o Data migration scripts
• Experience using Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core.
• Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
• Experience developing REST APIs and integrating with third-party services.
• Experience with dependency injection and service-based application architecture.
• Experience using Git and source control workflows.
• Good understanding of application security, authentication and role-based permissions.
• Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical and business problems.
• Ability to work with existing applications and understand established business logic.
• Strong attention to detail and a focus on producing reliable, supportable software.
• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a small development team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

The following experience would be beneficial but is not essential:

• VB.NET development experience.

• WinForms or WPF application development.
• Experience modernising or migrating desktop applications to web technologies.
• Crystal Reports development and support.
• Experience converting Crystal Reports into web-based or alternative reporting solutions.
• Microsoft Azure experience, including:
o Azure App Service
o Azure SQL Database
o Azure Storage
o Azure Functions
o Application Insights
o Key Vault
o Azure DevOps
o Microsoft Entra ID
• Experience with Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL), single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
• Experience building multi-tenant or multi-company SaaS applications.
• Experience with MAUI or cross-platform application development.
• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web design.
• Experience with component libraries such as Ignite UI.
• Experience developing dashboards, charts and operational reporting.
• Knowledge of background processing, scheduled services and message queues.
• Experience with document generation, barcode printing, label printing or local printing services.
• Experience integrating accounting, shipping, CRM, ERP or asset management systems.
• Experience working with AI development tools such as OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot or Azure AI services.
• Knowledge of prompt design, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation or vector search.
• Familiarity with secure software development practices and standards such as ISO 27001.
• Experience working within rental, asset management, service, maintenance, logistics or certification-based industries.

Technical Environment

The successful candidate is likely to work with technologies including:

  • C#
  • VB.NET
  • .NET and ASP.NET Core
  • Blazor Server
  • Entity Framework Core
  • SQL Server
  • Azure SQL Database
  • REST APIs
  • HTML and CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Entra ID and MSAL
  • Git and Azure DevOps
  • Crystal Reports
  • WinForms and WPF
  • .NET MAUI
  • OpenAI Codex and Azure AI services

Personal Characteristics

  • Practical and solutions-focused, with a passion for delivering business value.

  • Commercially aware, with the ability to connect technical solutions to business needs.

  • Confident working within complex and established technology environments.

  • Accountable, proactive, and committed to seeing work through to completion.

  • Focused on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and reliability.

  • Open to change, continuous improvement, and innovation.

  • Strong communicator with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Adaptable and effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Committed to the responsible use of AI and modern technologies to improve outcomes and efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

• A degree or equivalent qualification in software development, computer science or a related subject is desirable.
• Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.
• Previous experience in a commercial software development role is required.
• Experience delivering business-critical software to external customers would be advantageous.

Working Arrangements

This role will involve working closely with C-SAM’s development, operations, professional services and management teams.
The position may be office-based, hybrid or remote depending on the successful candidate’s location and experience.
Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer workshops, implementation support or training.
Some flexibility may occasionally be required when supporting international customers operating in different time zones.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to help shape a new application framework and product platform.
• A varied role involving new development, architecture, integrations and modernisation.
• Exposure to international customers and complex operational software.
• The opportunity to work with modern Microsoft and AI technologies.
• A small-team environment where individual contributions have a visible impact.
• Opportunities to influence technical direction, development standards and future products.
• Ongoing professional development and training.

Measures of Success

Success in the role will include:

• Delivering reliable functionality within agreed timescales.
• Producing maintainable and reusable framework components.
• Reducing defects and support issues through good design and testing.
• Improving application and database performance.

jobs.excerpt: Senior C++ Software EngineerRemote (UK-based) | Full-TimeAbout UsReactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year ().
jobs.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a C++ Software Engineer who wants to build low-latency trading infrastructure on Linux. You'll work on the core components of our Switchboard trading platform — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (3+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Experience with performance-sensitive systems (profiling, optimisation, deterministic behaviour)

  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (TCP/UDP, socket programming)

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

jobs.description:
About The Bridgespan Group

The Bridgespan Group (“Bridgespan”) is a global nonprofit that aims to build a better world by strengthening the ability of mission-driven organizations, philanthropists, impact investors, and corporations to achieve breakthrough results in addressing society’s most important challenges and opportunities.

Founded in 2000, Bridgespan has offices in Boston, Johannesburg, Mumbai, New York, San Francisco, and Singapore. Across these six locations, we have a diverse team of staff with varied backgrounds and experience across multiple sectors. We work with social change organizations such as TaRL Africa, Tiko, and CAMFED; philanthropies and foundations such as OSF, Women First Fund, and The Ford Foundation; impact investors such as TPG’s Rise Fund, Black Ambition, and AfricInvest; and bold funding collaboratives such as TED’s Audacious Project and Co-Impact.

Bridgespan aims for a world where all people have the opportunity to flourish. Given how society works today—as manifest in systems and mindsets that have developed over time—that opportunity is not accessible to all. We are committed to equity, specifically to doing work to help ensure that race, gender, and other dimensions of identity are not determinants of life outcomes and to building an organization where the diverse set of individuals we need can thrive in pursuit of their full professional potential, and to proactively addressing the systems that help or hinder these goals. It is a commitment to both external equity work and internal inclusivity that gets Bridgespan closer to achieving its mission.

Position

The Cloud Systems Engineer role is a cloud-first, execution-focused position responsible for administering, configuring, and operating modern IT infrastructure with a primary emphasis on Microsoft Azure and identity services within Microsoft Entra ID.

The role also contributes to cloud engineering and architecture initiatives, infrastructure automation, cloud governance, scalability planning, and modernization. The ideal candidate combines strong operational expertise with hands-on cloud engineering and automation experience.

Part of the IT Infrastructure team, this position ensures cloud and identity platforms are reliable, secure, and aligned with established architectural direction.

Objectives of the Role

  • Ensure reliability, performance, and security of identity systems using Microsoft Entra ID and integrated SaaS platforms.

  • Partner with IT leadership to implement and operationalize cloud and identity solutions.

  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates to standardize and automate repeatable, scalable cloud infrastructure deployments.

  • Implements and maintains Azure governance including Azure Policy, RBAC standards, tagging, resource organization, and cost optimization.

  • Contribute significantly to cloud modernization and automation initiatives that improve scalability, resiliency, and operational efficiency.

  • Enhance monitoring, alerting, and observability to proactively identify and resolve infrastructure issues, minimizing downtime and user impact.

  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to support CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Action.

  • Support containerized workloads and cloud-native platforms including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Docker-based deployments.

  • Support and mentor junior team members while contributing to a culture of continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

  • Configure and maintain Microsoft Entra ID, including users, groups, roles, Conditional Access policies, MFA, and identity lifecycle processes.

  • Administer and support Azure infrastructure including virtual machines, storage accounts, networking, and platform services.

  • Manage Windows Server environments hosted in Azure virtual machines, including Active Directory domain controllers, DNS, DHCP, and file servers.

  • Implement and support identity integrations for enterprise and SaaS applications using SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect.

  • Support file storage solutions including Azure Files, SharePoint Online, and VM-based file services, ensuring appropriate access controls and data protection.

  • Monitor system performance and availability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related tools; respond to and resolve incidents within defined service levels.

  • Execute system updates, patching, vulnerability remediation, and configuration changes across cloud and identity platforms.

  • Support engineering and development teams by provisioning resources, managing access, and troubleshooting infrastructure and identity issues.

  • Manage and resolve infrastructure and identity-related tickets through the service management system, ensuring accurate documentation and timely resolution.

  • Track and contribute to project work, including executing assigned tasks, updating progress, and identifying risks or blockers.

  • Collaborate with security teams on compliance, risk management, and implementation of security best practices aligned with Zero Trust principles.

  • Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and procedures to ensure consistency and knowledge sharing.

  • Participate in change management processes including planning, testing, and documenting changes in alignment with ITIL practices.

  • Provide escalation support for complex technical issues and participate in on-call support as needed.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

  • 5–8+ years of experience in systems administration, with strong experience in Microsoft Azure cloud environments.

  • Azure certifications: AZ-104 (required), AZ-305 (preferred) and/or identity certifications SC-300 (preferred).

  • Hands-on experience managing Windows Server workloads including Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, and file services in cloud-hosted environments.

  • Strong experience administering Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, MFA, and identity governance concepts.

  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Teams.

  • Proficiency with PowerShell and/or Azure CLI for automation and administration.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across cloud infrastructure, Windows systems, and identity platforms.

  • Understanding of authentication and identity protocols including SAML, OAuth, and OpenID Connect.

  • Experience working within ticketing systems and tracking operational and project-based work.

  • Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and support both operational and project-based initiatives.

  • Ability to work independently and remain flexible in a changing environment.

  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects with strong attention to detail.

PLEASE NOTE: YOU MUST BE ELIGIBLE TO WORK IN THE US WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP, THE BRIDGESPAN GROUP IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP

At Bridgespan, we are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion because we are passionate about helping our clients achieve breakthrough results. An organization that reflects the diversity of our clients and their beneficiaries will produce deeper relationships, engagement, and insights. Bridgespan is committed to providing equal opportunities. We serve diverse organizations and are committed to non-discrimination. Bridgespan will not discriminate against any employee with respect to any term or condition of employment, including but not limited to less favorable treatment, exclusion from employment or employment opportunities (including hiring, assignment, performance assessment and promotion) on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, gender (including pregnancy), gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, expression, veteran’s status or other protected characteristics or status. We actively partner with organizations representing minority concerns and interests to build high-performing teams that mirror the communities we serve.

All company sponsored programs including training, job, social and recreational activities are required to be nondiscriminatory and all human resource practices are monitored to ensure equal opportunity.

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote (on-site emergency availability required) Employment Type: Independent Contractor (LLC) Experience Level: Senior (7+ years) Salary: $72-$82/hr.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (on-site emergency availability required)
Employment Type: Independent Contractor (LLC)
Experience Level: Senior (7+ years)

Salary: $72-$82/hr.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer to provide senior-level systems administration and Azure platform support. This hands-on role is approximately 75% traditional Windows Systems Administration and operational support and 25% troubleshooting and support for a custom Azure-native messaging platform. The ideal contractor is a strong senior systems administrator with deep Microsoft enterprise skills, Azure troubleshooting, scripting and automation experience, strong customer service, and the ability to own complex incidents through resolution. This is not intended to be a pure DevOps platform-engineering role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and support Windows Server environments, including configuration, patching, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, security hardening, and operational improvement.
  • Manage Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, including hybrid identity, Exchange Hybrid, Microsoft Teams and eDiscovery, users, groups, access controls, and permissions.
  • Administer DNS/Infoblox, SSL/TLS certificates, privileged access functions, enterprise FTP services, file shares, and NTFS permissions.
  • Respond to service requests and incidents, serve as an escalation point for complex infrastructure issues, and support after-hours maintenance, on-call activities, and emergency operations when required.
  • Support and troubleshoot a custom Azure-native messaging solution through log/telemetry analysis, root-cause analysis, configuration review, deployment troubleshooting, and reliability improvements.
  • Troubleshoot Azure Service Bus, API Management, Azure Functions or similar compute services, Cosmos DB or Azure SQL, Key Vault, Managed Identity/RBAC, and Azure networking for PaaS services.
  • Use PowerShell, Python, Terraform/Terragrunt, Git/GitHub, C#, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, KQL, and approved AI-assisted engineering tools for automation, infrastructure-as-code, validation, observability, troubleshooting, refactoring, and documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, or enterprise IT operations with demonstrated senior-level technical ownership and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong hands-on Windows Server administration experience in an enterprise environment, including performance, security, patching, troubleshooting, and core infrastructure services.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, hybrid identity, Exchange Hybrid, Microsoft Teams/eDiscovery, DNS, certificate management, access controls, and file permissions.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting and operational automation experience; experience using Python for administration, API checks, validation, reporting, log analysis, or repeatable troubleshooting workflows.
  • Experience supporting Microsoft Azure environments and troubleshooting Azure-hosted applications/services, including platform configuration, deployments, messaging, identity, and monitoring.
  • Working experience with Terraform or Terragrunt and Git/GitHub; strong customer-facing support and cross-team collaboration skills; must be available on-site during emergencies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure Government (AzureUSGovernment), Azure PaaS networking, Azure observability, and integration/message-flow troubleshooting.
  • Ability to read, troubleshoot, and make targeted corrections to C#/.NET and Python code; experience with Kubernetes or containerized workloads is beneficial but not required.
  • Experience leveraging approved generative AI or AI-assisted development tools for DevOps scripting, Terraform/IaC, debugging, root-cause and log/KQL analysis, refactoring, deployment validation, and runbook creation; ability to validate AI-generated output and safeguard credentials and sensitive information.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Windows Server Hybrid Administrator, Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, Azure DevOps Engineer, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience accepted. Operational documentation and runbook experience is also preferred.

Why Contract with Us?

  • Contract is with local government entity
  • Serve in a high-impact senior technical role supporting mission-critical public services across traditional Microsoft enterprise technologies and modern Azure-native services.
  • Support a strategic Azure-hosted messaging platform while strengthening automation, reliability, and troubleshooting capabilities through an independent contractor engagement with competitive hourly compensation.

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who wants to build the interface layer of a product that's actually changing how lawyers work.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who wants to build the interface layer of a product that's actually changing how lawyers work. You'll be shaping how legal professionals across Europe interact with AI-powered legal research, working on the kind of UI problems that don't have textbook answers: streaming AI reasoning, dense document interfaces, and search that has to feel instant on top of millions of legal sources. If you care deeply about craft, like ambiguity, and want a lot of room to shape what gets built, keep reading.

📍 This role can be based in our Copenhagen HQ or remotely from Europe.

About Pandektes

Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than €4 million and most recently closed a €2.9 million seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and leading angels. Pandektes already serves more than 350 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

About the role

You'll have real room to shape both what we build and how we build it. You'll work across our most ambitious surfaces: the document viewer where lawyers read and annotate legislation and case law, the AI chat that walks them through complex legal reasoning, and the search and navigation layer that ties it all together.

This is a role for someone who cares about craft. We move fast, but we don't ship sloppy. You'll partner closely with design, product, and our backend and ML teams to take features from rough idea to polished production experience, and you'll have meaningful influence on the technical direction of the frontend as the team grows.

What you’ll do

  • Own end-to-end implementation of frontend features in our React, Next.js, and TypeScript codebase, from architecture decisions to shipping polished UI

  • Build and maintain our most complex surfaces: AI chat with streaming reasoning, PDF and document viewers, modal stacks, search and navigation

  • Help shape our component library and frontend architecture as we scale our team

  • Partner with design and product to turn ambiguous problems into shipped features that legal professionals actually love using

  • Raise the bar for quality across the team through code review, technical direction, and shared standards

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of frontend experience, with deep expertise in React and TypeScript

  • Strong working knowledge of Next.js (App Router preferred)

  • Solid CSS fundamentals and comfort with a modern styling approach (Tailwind, CSS modules, or similar)

  • A track record of shipping complex stateful UIs in production, not just CRUD forms

  • Strong product instincts and design sensibility. You spot bad UX and propose better

  • Direct, low-ego communication. You give and take feedback well, and you lift teammates up

  • Curiosity about the domain - you want to understand the why behind what users need, not just build the ticket

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating with LLM APIs (streaming responses, tool calls, structured outputs)

  • PDF or document viewer work, annotation, or other heavy-content rendering

  • Design-system or component-library ownership

  • Accessibility (WCAG) experience

  • Some backend or full-stack comfort (Node, basic API work)

  • Legal-tech, fintech, or another regulated-domain background

How we work

We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in our Copenhagen HQ and remotely from Germany, Switzerland, Austria and London. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

What we offer

  • A central role in a fast-growing company with €4M+ raised, most recently a €2.9M seed led by People Ventures and Interface Capital

  • A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

  • 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

  • International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

  • An attractive warrant program

  • Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

  • Paid parental leave

jobs.description:
About Utorg

Founded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure for stablecoin payments: on- and off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards. Over 2 million users across 130+ countries already buy, hold, and spend crypto through our app. On the B2B side, the same rails power 2,100+ platforms, with $2.4B+ moved to date.

Fully MiCA-authorized across the EEA. PCI DSS Level 2 certified. Backed by Dragonfly, TA Ventures, and Hypra.

Location: Remote

Tech stack: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, NATS JetStream, Redis, Jest, Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform.

Blockchains: EVM-compatible, Bitcoin-family, Tron, Solana, TON.

What you’ll do:
  • Own backend architecture across two large-scale microservice platforms (30+ and 25+ services) — from system design and API contracts to data flow and inter-service communication.
  • Lead complex integrations — payment providers, card issuers, blockchain networks, third-party APIs — and take full responsibility for their reliability in production.
  • Drive performance and scalability — identify bottlenecks, design caching strategies, optimize database queries, and ensure the platform handles growing load.
  • Shape technical direction — make architectural decisions, evaluate trade-offs, and influence the team’s engineering standards. You’ll partially offload the Tech Lead so the team can scale.
  • Build and improve AI-powered processes — our team actively uses LLM-based systems to automate operational and development workflows. You’ll contribute to and extend this direction.
  • Contribute to back-office frontends (~20% of your time) — maintain and extend React-based admin dashboards used by internal teams.
  • Own features end-to-end — from planning and architectural design to implementation, testing, production monitoring, and iterative improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, QA, and cross-functional teams — produce clear technical documentation, participate in code reviews, and share knowledge.
  • Take part in a shared on-call rotation — roughly one week a month.
Who you are:
  • Technically strong with an architectural mindset — you don’t just write code, you design systems. You think about data flows, failure modes, and long-term maintainability before writing the first line.
  • Opinionated and able to defend your decisions — you bring an expert perspective to technical discussions and can articulate trade-offs clearly to both engineers and stakeholders.
  • Proactive problem-solver — you find issues before they become incidents and propose solutions without waiting to be asked.
  • Product-driven — most of your time goes into shipping features and solving real user problems, not open-ended refactoring.
  • Self-motivated and responsible — you thrive in small teams, enjoy autonomy, and take full ownership of the development process.
What you will bring:
  • 5+ years of production experience in backend development with Type Script/Node.js as the primary stack.
  • 2+ years with NestJS in production — modules, providers, middleware, guards, interceptors, microservice architecture with custom transports.
  • Deep PostgreSQL expertise — schema design, indexing (partial, GIN/GiST), query optimization, migrations with zero-downtime, database-per-service pattern.
  • Hands-on microservices experience — not a monolith split into modules. You’ve dealt with inter-service communication (RPC + pub/sub), message brokers, idempotency, eventual consistency, saga/outbox patterns.
  • System design experience — decomposing services, designing API contracts, data flow architecture, capacity planning. You can whiteboard a system and explain why you made each decision.
  • Complex integration experience — you’ve built and maintained integrations with third-party APIs, payment systems, or similar external services in production. You know how to handle retries, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
  • Performance engineering— profiling, caching strategies, load analysis, bottleneck identification. You can optimize a slow query and a slow service alike.
  • Production blockchain experience (MUST-HAVE) — you’ve worked with on-chain transactions, multiple networks, and real user funds. You understand HD wallets (BIP32/BIP39), smart contracts, ABI, ERC-20/SPL tokens, and the differences between account-based and UTXO models. Experience with libraries like ethers.js, viem, and solana/web3.js.
  • AI-driven development (MUST-HAVE) — you actively use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Cursor) in your daily workflow. Beyond personal productivity, you have experience optimizing business or organizational processes with AI/LLMs—building automations, internal tools, or workflows powered by language models.
  • Strong testing discipline — unit tests (Jest), integration tests with real databases, microservice testing.
  • Security-conscious — in fintech and crypto, every code path can touch real user funds. You build accordingly.
  • Skilled in technical research — evaluating trade-offs, testing hypotheses, and making data-driven architectural decisions.
  • English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate. Fluent in the Russian language.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with NATS JetStream as a transport layer (streams, consumers, delivery policies).
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus + Grafana, structured logging (pino), distributed tracing.
  • Kubernetes beyond basics: Kustomize/Helm, deployment strategies, resource management.
  • Fintech domain knowledge: PCI DSS, GDPR, KYC/AML, payment systems.
  • Experience mentoring junior/middle developers.
  • React basics for back-office UIs (functional components, hooks, Redux, Material-UI).

Interaction with other teams:

Close collaboration with Product, QA, Frontend, and Mobile. Cross-functional communication is an essential part of the role. Partially offload the Tech Lead: own architectural and technical decisions, independently drive complex integrations, and influence the platform's technical direction. This is not an executor role. We need someone with strong expert opinions who can be relied upon for key technical decisions.

Key results (30-60-90):

30 days: First features shipped to production. Deep dive into the stack, architecture, and domain (blockchain, fintech). Clear understanding of core services and how they interact.

60 days: Independently drives a complex integration or a major feature. Participates in architectural code reviews. Brings first proposals for improvements.

90 days: Makes architectural decisions on their scope. Influences technical direction. Partially offloads the Tech Lead in decision-making. Participates in planning.

What we offer:
  • Work fully remote as part of an agile, international team reshaping the future of finance.
  • An engineering culture that encourages the adoption of modern tools and development practices, giving engineers real influence over technologies, workflows, and technical decisions.
  • Two career tracks — grow into Tech Lead or deepen your expertise as Staff/Principal IC. You choose the path.
  • Career progression and professional development in a forward-thinking fintech environment.
  • Competitive salary range based on individual performance review.
  • Transparent feedback and a culture that values ownership, open dialogue, and visible impact.
Recruitment Process

  1. Application. Submit your application and CV.

  2. Application Review. Our team reviews your experience and qualifications.

  3. HR Interview. An introductory conversation to discuss your professional background and expectations.

  4. Technical Interview. Assessment of your technical expertise, system design skills, and relevant experience.

  5. Team Lead Interview. A discussion focused on team fit, collaboration style, and alignment with engineering culture.

  6. Offer. Receiving the offer and details about the next steps.

  • Experience with infrastructure automation tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.

  • Experience using Service Management ticketing systems, such as Jira.
  • Understanding of repositories, specifically GitHub.
  • Understanding of file-sharing technologies.
  • Git knowledge.

WHAT WE OFFER

Why Pythian:

At Pythian, we are experts in strategic database and analytics services, driving digital transformation and operational excellence. Pythian, a multinational company, was founded in 1997 and started by ensuring the reliability and performance of mission-critical databases. We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

The Team Manager will lead a team of Site Reliability Engineers, promoting the development and execution of quality services and continuous improvements in support of the company’s goal of providing superior client experience, promoting a culture of high performance and continuous learning and development.

The Team Manager will be responsible for the delivery of high-quality technical services and adherence to Pythian and client processes; lead their team through the implementation of customized client services; be an influential leader with talent in people management; Champion a culture of continuous improvement and development of team members.

Hours of Work: We have two positions available as we are creating two teams. One position will have the hours of 4:30am to 1pm IST and the other will be 12:30pm to 9pm IST.

As a first step in the application, you will be required to complete an online technical assessment so that we better understand your SRE technical skills.

What you will be doing:

  • Lead and mentor a team of SRE to ensure technical excellence, timely resolution of incidents, and professional growth of team members.
  • Drive strategic service delivery and operational excellence by optimizing workload distribution, automating toil, and ensuring the team exceeds strict SLA targets for high-profile enterprise clients.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for critical escalations and severity-1 incidents, providing guidance and technical direction.
  • Provide 24/7 management on-call support for the team.
  • Conduct performance reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions to strengthen the team’s capabilities.
  • Collaborate with management on performance metrics, process adherence, and resource planning.
  • Sets specific goals and objectives for team members as part of Pythian’s goal planning program.
  • Provides guidance to team members regarding training opportunities as part of Pythian’s self-directed training program.
  • Meets regularly with team members for one-on-one sessions to disseminate information and gain feedback on opportunities for improvement.
  • Reviews and reports on technical work completed by team members.
  • Ensures team members’ adherence to Pythian and client processes.
  • Works with the Director to complete resource planning to enable sustainable growth.
  • Act as a strategic technical advisor to key enterprise clients, deeply understanding their business goals and tailoring Pythian’s SRE/DevOps services to drive their long-term infrastructure reliability and scalability.
  • Works with the Director to disseminate information and direction from Pythian’s leadership teams.
  • Foster a culture of psychological safety, encouraging proactive problem-solving, blameless post-mortems, and continuous innovation among senior technical staff.

What we need from you:

  • A minimum of 3 years of previous experience leading and managing technical teams, specifically with a track record of guiding senior-level SRE and DevOps engineers.
  • Proven experience managing complex, high-stakes enterprise client relationships. Ability to confidently interface with high-level client stakeholders and act as a trusted advisor.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. Must be able to seamlessly translate complex technical challenges and strategic goals between C-level executives and highly technical engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated resilience and composure under pressure. Strong crisis management and escalation handling skills, with a proven ability to steer teams through significant technical, operational, and client-facing challenges.
  • Proven experience in SRE and/or DevOps with a strong SRE and DevOps mindset and a relentless focus on CI/CD orchestration, release management, deployment automation, scalability, toil reduction, and system reliability.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, particularly Terraform.
  • Strong knowledge of microservices architecture, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), advanced networking concepts, and CI/CD pipeline tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Hands-on experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), service mesh technologies, and Linux systems administration.

What you will receive:

  • Love your career: Competitive total rewards package. Blog during work hours; take a day off and volunteer for your favorite charity.
  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favourite charity.

  • Capacidad para realizar troubleshooting de problemas complejos en plataformas distribuidas y contenerizadas

  • Buenas capacidades de comunicación, organización y trabajo con diferentes equipos

jobs.description:
Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)

Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

  • Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong background in one of the below:

    • TypeScript / JavaScript

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

    • Cursor

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement Details

  • Rate: $100–$200/hour

  • Hours: ~10–20 hours/week

  • Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)

  • Start: ASAP

  • Process:

    • Take-home evaluation exercise

    • One behavioral interview

jobs.description:
Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)

Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

  • Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong background in one of the below:

    • TypeScript / JavaScript

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

    • Cursor

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement Details

  • Rate: $100–$200/hour

  • Hours: ~10–20 hours/week

  • Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)

  • Start: ASAP

  • Process:

    • Take-home evaluation exercise

    • One behavioral interview
